_comment: Map UNC paths from the database to local mount points per OS. Direct access is faster than streaming via the API.
_example_mac: On Mac, mount via Finder > Connect to Server > smb://diskstation. Default mount is /Volumes/triviavideo.
_example_linux: On Linux, mount via mount.cifs or fstab to /mnt/diskstation/triviavideo etc.
_example_windows: On Windows you can also map a drive letter (e.g. Z:) for faster access.
